Name: PID_InstructionList
Code:
(* ==============================================
   PID Controller — Instruction List (IL)
   
   Demonstrates the same PID loop as the ST version
   but written in IEC 61131-3 Instruction List.
   Enable this program and disable the ST version
   to switch control to IL mode.
   ============================================== *)

(* Load process variable *)
LD   0.0
ST   %pv
LD   0.0
ST   %sp
LD   0.0
ST   %output

(* Read PV and SP from OPC *)
CAL  Read('Process.Temperature')
ST   %pv
CAL  Read('Process.Setpoint')
ST   %sp

(* Read PID gains *)
CAL  Read('PID.Kp')
ST   %kp
CAL  Read('PID.Ki')
ST   %ki
CAL  Read('PID.Kd')
ST   %kd

(* Calculate error *)
LD   %sp
SUB  %pv
ST   %error

(* Proportional term: Kp * error *)
LD   %kp
MUL  %error
ST   %pTerm

(* Integral term: accumulate error *)
LD   %integral
ADD  %error
ST   %integral
LD   %ki
MUL  %integral
ST   %iTerm

(* Derivative term: error - prevError *)
LD   %error
SUB  %prevError
ST   %dTerm
LD   %kd
MUL  %dTerm
ST   %dTerm

(* Sum P + I + D *)
LD   %pTerm
ADD  %iTerm
ADD  %dTerm
ST   %output

(* Clamp output 0..100 *)
LD   %output
GT   100.0
JMPC ClampHigh
LD   %output
LT   0.0
JMPC ClampLow
JMP  WriteOut

ClampHigh:
LD   100.0
ST   %output
JMP  WriteOut

ClampLow:
LD   0.0
ST   %output

WriteOut:
(* Write output *)
LD   %output
ST   %output
CAL  Write('Process.HeaterOutput', %output)

(* Save previous error *)
LD   %error
ST   %prevError

(* --- Process Simulation --- *)
CAL  Read('Process.Temperature')
ST   %simPv
CAL  Read('Simulation.ProcessGain')
ST   %simGain
CAL  Read('Simulation.TimeConstant')
ST   %simTau
CAL  Read('Process.CoolingDisturbance')
ST   %simDist

(* dpv = (-pv + gain*output - dist*tau) / tau *)
LD   %simGain
MUL  %output
ST   %simTemp
LD   %simPv
MUL  -1.0
ADD  %simTemp
LD   %simDist
MUL  %simTau
ST   %simTemp2
LD   %simTemp
SUB  %simTemp2
ST   %simTemp

(* Divide by tau, scale by dt=0.1 *)
LD   %simTemp
DIV  %simTau
MUL  0.1
ADD  %simPv
ST   %simPv

(* Clamp 0..200 *)
LD   %simPv
GT   200.0
JMPC SimHigh
LD   %simPv
LT   0.0
JMPC SimLow
JMP  SimWrite

SimHigh:
LD   200.0
ST   %simPv
JMP  SimWrite

SimLow:
LD   0.0
ST   %simPv

SimWrite:
CAL  Write('Process.Temperature', %simPv)
